title: Cart total is wrong after removing an item
description:
After removing an item from the cart, the cart total does not update until the page is reloaded.
Steps to reproduce: 1) Add two different items to the cart. 2) Click Remove on the first item. 3) Look at the total.
Expected: total equals the price of the remaining item immediately.
Actual: total still includes the removed item until refresh.
Environment: web app, Chrome, staging.
